mn26:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn26:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya Sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
mn26:2.2: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yen' āyasmā Ānando ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etad-avocuṃ:
mn26:2.3: Cirassutā no āvuso Ānanda Bhagavato sammukhā dhammī kathā,
mn26:2.4: sādhu mayaṃ āvuso Ānanda labheyyāma Bhagavato sammukhā dhammikaṃ kathaṃ savanāyāti. --
mn26:2.5: Tena h' āyasmanto yena Rammakassa brāhmaṇassa assamo ten' upasaṅkamatha,
mn26:2.6: app-eva nāma labheyyātha Bhagavato sammukhā dhammikaṃ kathaṃ savanāyāti. --
mn26:2.7: Evam-āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Ānandassa paccassosuṃ.
mn26:3.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:
mn26:3.2: Āyām' Ānanda yena Pubbārāmo Migāramātu pāsādo ten' upasaṅkamissāma divāvihārāyāti.
mn26:3.3: Evaṃ bhante ti kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavato paccassosi.
mn26:3.4: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmatā Ānandena saddhiṃ yena Pubbārāmo Migāramātu pāsādo ten' upasaṅkami divāvihārāya.
mn26:3.5: Atha kho Bhagavā sāyanhasamayaṃ patisallāṇā vuṭṭhito āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:
mn26:3.6: Āyām' Ānanda yena Pubbakoṭṭhako ten' upasaṅkamissāma gattāni parisiñcitun-ti.
mn26:3.7: Evam-bhante ti kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavato paccassosi.
mn26:3.8: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmatā Ānandena saddhiṃ yena Pubbakoṭṭhako ten' upasaṅkami gattāni parisiñcituṃ;
mn26:3.9: Pubbakoṭṭhake gattāni parisiñcitvā paccuttaritvā ekacīvaro aṭṭhāsi gattāni pubbāpayamāno.
mn26:3.10: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad-avoca:
mn26:3.11: Ayaṃ bhante Rammakassa brāhmaṇassa assamo avidūre;
mn26:3.14: sādhu bhante Bhagavā yena Rammakassa brāhmaṇassa assamo ten' upasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
mn26:4.1: Atha kho Bhagavā yena Rammakassa brāhmaṇassa assamo ten' upasaṅkami.
mn26:4.2: Tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū Rammakassa brāhmaṇassa assame dhammiyā kathāya sannisinnā honti.
mn26:4.3: Atha kho Bhagavā bahidvārakoṭṭhake aṭṭhāsi kathāpariyosānaṃ āgamayamāno.
mn26:4.4: Atha kho Bhagavā kathāpariyosānaṃ viditvā ukkāsitvā aggaḷaṃ ākoṭesi;
mn26:4.5: vivariṃsu kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato dvāraṃ.
mn26:4.6: Atha kho Bhagavā Rammakassa brāhmaṇassa assamaṃ pavisitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
mn26:4.8: Kāya nu ' ttha bhikkhave etarahi kathāya sannisinnā, kā ca pana vo antarākathā vippakatā ti.
mn26:4.9: Bhagavantam-eva kho no bhante ārabbha dhammī kathā vippakatā, atha Bhagavā anuppatto ti.
mn26:4.11: etaṃ kho bhikkhave tumhākaṃ patirūpaṃ kulaputtānaṃ saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitānaṃ yaṃ tumhe dhammiyā kathāya sannisīdeyyātha.
mn26:4.13: dhammī vā kathā ariyo vā tuṇhībhāvo.
mn26:5.2: ariyā ca pariyesanā anariyā ca pariyesanā.
mn26:5.4: Idha bhikkhave ekacco attanā jātidhammo samāno jātidhammañ-ñeva pariyesati, attanā jarādhammo samāno jarādhammañ-ñeva pariyesati, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ attanā byādhidhammo . . . attanā maraṇadhammo . . . attanā sokadhammo . . . attanā saṅkilesadhammo samāno saṅkilesadhammañ-ñeva pariyesati.
mn26:6.2: Puttabhariyaṃ bhikkhave jātidhammaṃ, dāsidāsaṃ jātidhammaṃ, ajeḷakaṃ jātidhammaṃ, kukkuṭasūkaraṃ jātidhammaṃ, hatthigavāssavaḷavaṃ jātidhammaṃ, jātarūparajataṃ jātidhammaṃ.
mn26:6.4: etthāyaṃ gathito mucchito ajjhopanno attanā jātidhammo samāno jātidhammaññeva pariyesati.
mn26:7.2: Puttabhariyaṃ bhikkhave jarādhammaṃ, dāsidāsaṃ j., ajeḷakaṃ j., kukkuṭasūkaraṃ j., hatthigavāssavaḷavaṃ j., jātarūparajataṃ jarādhammaṃ.
mn26:7.4: etthāyaṃ gathito mucchito ajjhopanno attanā jarādhammo samāno jarādhammañ-ñeva pariyesati.
mn26:8.2: Puttabhariyaṃ bhikkhave byādhidhammaṃ, dāsidāsaṃ by., ajeḷakaṃ by., kukkuṭasūkaraṃ by., hatthigavāssavaḷavaṃ byādhidhammaṃ.
mn26:9.2: Puttabhariyaṃ bhikkhave maraṇadhammaṃ, dāsidāsaṃ m., ajeḷakaṃ m., kukkuṭasūkaraṃ m., hatthigavāssavaḷavaṃ maraṇadhammaṃ.
mn26:10.2: Puttabhariyaṃ bhikkhave sokadhammaṃ, dāsidāsaṃ s., ajeḷakaṃ s., kukkuṭasūkaraṃ s., hatthigavāssavaḷavaṃ sokadhammaṃ.
mn26:11.2: Puttabhariyaṃ bhikkhave saṅkilesadhammaṃ, dāsidāsaṃ saṅkilesadhammaṃ, ajeḷakaṃ saṅkilesadhammaṃ, kukkuṭasūkaraṃ saṅkilesadhammaṃ, hatthigavāssavaḷavaṃ saṅkilesadhammaṃ, jātarūparajataṃ saṅkilesadhammaṃ.
mn26:11.4: etthāyaṃ gathito mucchito ajjhopanno attanā saṅkilesadhammo samāno saṅkilesadhammañ-ñeva pariyesati.
mn26:12.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco attanā jātidhammo samāno jātidhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā ajātaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesati, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ attanā jarādhammo samāno jarādhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā ajaraṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesati, attanā byādhidhammo samāno . . . abyādhiṃ . . ., attanā maraṇadhammo samāno . . . amataṃ . . ., attanā sokadhammo samāno . . . asokaṃ . . ., attanā saṅkilesadhammo samāno saṅkilesadhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā asaṅkiliṭṭhaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesati.
mn26:13.1: Aham-pi sudaṃ bhikkhave pubbe va sambodhā anabhisambuddho bodhisatto va samāno attanā jātidhammo samāno jātidhammañ-ñeva pariyesāmi, attanā jarādhammo samāno jarādhammañ-ñeva pariyesāmi, attanā byādhidhammo . . ., attanā maraṇadhammo . . ., attanā sokadhammo . . ., attanā saṅkilesadhammo samāno saṅkilesadhammañ-ñeva pariyesāmi.
mn26:13.3: Kin-nu kho ahaṃ attanā jātidhammo samāno jātidhammañ-ñeva pariyesāmi, attanā jarādhammo samāno --pe-- attanā saṅkilesadhammo samāno saṅkilesadhammañ-ñeva pariyesāmi;
mn26:13.4: yan-nūnāhaṃ attanā jātidhammo samāno jātidhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā ajātaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyeseyyaṃ, attanā jarādhammo . . . ajaraṃ . . . pariyeseyyaṃ, attanā byādhidhammo . . . abyādhiṃ . . . pariyeseyyaṃ, attanā maraṇadhammo . . . amataṃ . . . pariyeseyyaṃ, attanā sokadhammo . . . asokaṃ . . . pariyeseyyaṃ, attanā saṅkilesadhammo samāno saṅkilesadhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā asaṅkiliṭṭham anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyeseyyan-ti.
mn26:14.1: So kho ahaṃ bhikkhave aparena samayena daharo va samāno susu kāḷakeso bhadrena yobbanena samannāgato paṭhamena vayasā akāmakānaṃ mātāpitunnaṃ assumukhānaṃ rudantānaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajiṃ.
mn26:15.1: So evaṃ pabbajito samāno kiṃkusalagavesī anuttaraṃ santivarapadaṃ pariyesamāno yena Āḷāro Kālāmo ten' upasaṅkamiṃ, upasaṅkamitvā Āḷāraṃ Kālāmaṃ etad-avocaṃ:
mn26:15.2: Icchām' ahaṃ āvuso Kālāma imasmiṃ dhammavinaye brahmacariyaṃ caritun-ti.
mn26:15.3: Evaṃ vutte bhikkhave Āḷāro Kālāmo maṃ etadavoca:
mn26:15.5: tādiso ayaṃ dhammo yattha viññū puriso nacirass' eva sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyāti. \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn26:15.6: So kho ahaṃ bhikkhave nacirass' eva khippam-eva taṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇiṃ.
mn26:15.7: So kho ahaṃ bhikkhave tāvataken' eva oṭṭhapahatamattena lapitalāpanamattena ñāṇavādañ-ca vadāmi theravādañ-ca, jānāmi passāmīti ca paṭijānāmi ahañ-c' eva aññe ca.
mn26:15.9: Na kho Āḷāro Kālāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ kevalaṃ saddhāmattakena: sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmīti pavedeti,
mn26:15.10: addhā Āḷāro Kālāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ jānaṃ passaṃ viharatīti.
mn26:15.11: Atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave yena Āḷāro Kālāmo ten' upasaṅkamiṃ, upasaṅkamitvā Āḷāraṃ Kālāmaṃ etad-avocaṃ:
mn26:15.12: Kittāvatā no āvuso Kālāma imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesīti.
mn26:15.13: Evaṃ vutte bhikkhave Āḷāro Kālāmo ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ pavedesi.
mn26:15.15: Na kho Āḷārass' eva Kālāmassa atthi saddhā, mayhaṃ p' atthi saddhā;
mn26:15.16: na kho Āḷārass' eva Kālāmassa atthi viriyaṃ, mayhaṃ p' atthi viriyaṃ;
mn26:15.17: na kho Āḷārass' eva Kālāmassa atthi sati, mayhaṃ p' atthi sati;
mn26:15.18: na kho Āḷārass' eva Kālāmassa atthi samādhi, mayhaṃ p' atthi samādhi;
mn26:15.19: na kho Āḷārass' eva Kālāmassa atthi paññā, mayhaṃ p' atthi paññā;
mn26:15.20: yan-nūnāhaṃ yaṃ dhammaṃ Āḷāro Kālāmo: sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmīti pavedeti tassa dhammassa sacchikiriyāya padaheyyan-ti.
mn26:15.21: So kho ahaṃ bhikkhave nacirass' eva khippam-eva taṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
mn26:15.22: Atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave yena Āḷāro Kālāmo ten' upasaṅkamiṃ, upasaṅkamitvā Āḷāraṃ Kālāmaṃ etad-avocaṃ:
mn26:15.23: Ettāvatā no āvuso Kālāma imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesīti. --
mn26:15.24: Ettāvatā kho ahaṃ āvuso imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedemīti. --
mn26:15.25: Aham-pi kho āvuso ettāvatā imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmīti. --
mn26:15.26: Lābhā no āvuso, suladdhaṃ no āvuso,
mn26:15.27: ye mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ tādisaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ passāma.
mn26:15.28: Iti yāhaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedemi taṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharasi,
mn26:15.29: yaṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharasi tam-ahaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedemi. \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn26:15.30: Iti yāhaṃ dhammaṃ jānāmi taṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ jānāsi, yaṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ jānāsi tam-ahaṃ dhammaṃ jānāmi.
mn26:15.31: Iti yādiso ahaṃ tādiso tuvaṃ, yādiso tuvaṃ tādiso ahaṃ.
mn26:15.32: Ehi dāni āvuso, ubho va santā imaṃ gaṇaṃ pariharāmāti.
mn26:15.33: Iti kho bhikkhave Āḷāro Kālāmo ācariyo me samāno antevāsiṃ maṃ samānaṃ attano samasamaṃ ṭhapesi uḷārāya ca maṃ pūjāya pūjesi.
mn26:15.35: Nāyaṃ dhammo nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati, yāvad-eva ākiñcaññāyatanūpapattiyā ti.
mn26:15.36: So kho ahaṃ bhikkhave taṃ dhammaṃ analaṅkaritvā tasmā dhammā nibbijjāpakkamiṃ.
mn26:16.1: So kho ahaṃ bhikkhave kiṃkusalagavesī anuttaraṃ santivarapadaṃ pariyesamāno yena Uddako Rāmaputto ten' upasaṅkamiṃ, upasaṅkamitvā Uddakaṃ Rāmaputtaṃ etad-avocaṃ:
mn26:16.2: Icchām' ahaṃ āvuso imasmiṃ dhammavinaye brahmacariyaṃ caritun-ti.
mn26:16.3: Evaṃ vutte bhikkhave Uddako Rāmaputto maṃ etad-avoca:
mn26:16.5: tādiso ayaṃ dhammo yattha viññū puriso nacirass' eva sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyāti.
mn26:16.6: So kho ahaṃ bhikkhave nacirass' eva khippam-eva taṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇiṃ.
mn26:16.7: So kho ahaṃ bhikkhave tāvataken' eva oṭṭhapahatamattena lapitalāpanamattena ñāṇavādañ-ca vadāmi theravādañ-ca, jānāmi passāmīti ca paṭijānāmi ahañ-c' eva aññe ca.
mn26:16.9: Na kho Rāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ kevalaṃ saddhāmattakena: sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmīti pavedesi,
mn26:16.10: addhā Rāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ jānaṃ passaṃ vihāsīti.
mn26:16.11: Atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave yena Uddako Rāmaputto ten' upasaṅkamiṃ, upasaṅkamitvā Uddakaṃ Rāmaputtaṃ etad-avocaṃ:
mn26:16.12: Kittāvatā no āvuso Rāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesīti.
mn26:16.13: Evaṃ vutte bhikkhave Uddako Rāmaputto nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ pavedesi.
mn26:16.15: Na kho Rāmass' eva ahosi saddhā, mayhaṃ p' atthi saddhā;
mn26:16.16: na kho Rāmass' eva ahosi viriyaṃ, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ mayhaṃ p' atthi viriyaṃ;
mn26:16.17: na kho Rāmass' eva ahosi sati, mayhaṃ p' atthi sati;
mn26:16.18: na kho Rāmass' eva ahosi samādhi, mayhaṃ p' atthi samādhi;
mn26:16.19: na kho Rāmass' eva ahosi paññā, mayhaṃ p' atthi paññā;
mn26:16.20: yan-nūnāhaṃ yaṃ dhammaṃ Rāmo: sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmīti pavedesi tassa dhammassa sacchikiriyāya padaheyyan-ti.
mn26:16.21: So kho ahaṃ bhikkhave nacirass' eva khippam-eva taṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
mn26:16.22: Atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave yena Uddako Rāmaputto ten' upasaṅkamiṃ, upasaṅkamitvā Uddakaṃ Rāmaputtaṃ etad-avocaṃ:
mn26:16.23: Ettāvatā no āvuso Rāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesīti. --
mn26:16.24: Ettāvatā kho āvuso Rāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesīti. --
mn26:16.25: Aham-pi kho āvuso ettāvatā imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmīti. --
mn26:16.26: Lābhā no āvuso, suladdhaṃ no āvuso,
mn26:16.27: ye mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ tādisaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ passāma.
mn26:16.28: Iti yaṃ dhammaṃ Rāmo sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesi taṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharasi,
mn26:16.29: yaṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharasi taṃ dhammaṃ Rāmo sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesi.
mn26:16.30: Iti yaṃ dhammaṃ Rāmo aññāsi taṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ jānāsi, yaṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ jānāsi taṃ dhammaṃ Rāmo aññāsi.
mn26:16.31: Iti yādiso Rāmo ahosi tādiso tuvaṃ, yādiso tuvaṃ tādiso Rāmo ahosi.
mn26:16.32: Ehi dāni āvuso, tvaṃ imaṃ gaṇaṃ pariharāti.
mn26:16.33: Iti kho bhikkhave Uddako Rāmaputto sabrahmacārī me samāno ācariyaṭṭhāne ca maṃ ṭhapesi uḷārāya ca maṃ pūjāya pūjesi.
mn26:16.35: Nāyaṃ dhammo nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati, yāvad-eva nevasaññānāsaññāyatanūpapattiyā ti.
mn26:16.36: So kho ahaṃ bhikkhave taṃ dhammaṃ analaṅkaritvā tasmā dhammā nibbijjāpakkamiṃ.
mn26:17.1: So kho ahaṃ bhikkhave kiṃkusalagavesī anuttaraṃ santivarapadaṃ pariyesamāno Magadhesu anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Uruvelā senānigamo tad-avasariṃ.
mn26:17.2: Tatth' addasaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ bhūmibhāgaṃ pāsādikañ-ca vanasaṇḍaṃ, nadiñ-ca sandantiṃ setakaṃ sūpatitthaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ, samantā ca gocaragāmaṃ.
mn26:17.4: Ramaṇīyo vata bho bhūmibhāgo pāsādiko ca vanasaṇḍo, nadī ca sandati setakā sūpatitthā ramaṇīyā, samantā ca gocaragāmo;
mn26:17.5: alaṃ vat' idaṃ kulaputtassa padhānatthikassa padhānāyāti.
mn26:17.6: So kho ahaṃ bhikkhave tatth' eva nisīdiṃ:
mn26:18.1: So kho ahaṃ bhikkhave attanā jātidhammo samāno jātidhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā ajātaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesamāno ajātaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ ajjhagamaṃ, attanā jarādhammo samāno jarādhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā ajaraṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesamāno ajaraṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ ajjhagamaṃ, attanā byādhidhammo samāno byādhidhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā abyādhiṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesamāno abyādhiṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ ajjhagamaṃ, attanā maraṇadhammo samāno maraṇadhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā amataṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesamāno amataṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ ajjhagamaṃ, attanā sokadhammo samāno sokadhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā asokaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesamāno asokaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ ajjhagamaṃ, attanā saṅkilesadhammo samāno saṅkilesadhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā asaṅkiliṭṭhaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesamāno asaṅkiliṭṭhaṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ ajjhagamaṃ.
mn26:18.3: Akuppā me vimutti, ayam-antimā jāti, na-tthi dāni punabbhavo ti.
mn26:19.2: Adhigato kho me ayaṃ dhammo gambhīro duddaso duranubodho santo paṇīto atakkāvacaro nipuṇo paṇḍitavedanīyo.
mn26:19.3: Ālayarāmā kho panāyaṃ pajā ālayaratā ālayasammuditā.
mn26:19.4: Ālayarāmāya kho pana pajāya ālayaratāya ālayasammuditāya duddasaṃ idaṃ ṭhānaṃ yadidaṃ idappaccayatā paṭiccasamuppādo,
mn26:19.5: idam-pi kho ṭhānaṃ duddasaṃ yadidaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ.
mn26:19.6: Ahañ-c' eva kho pana dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ pare ca me na ājāneyyuṃ, so mam' assa kilamatho, sā mam' assa vihesā ti.
mn26:19.7: Api-ssu maṃ bhikkhave imā anacchariyā gāthā paṭibhaṃsu pubbe assutapubbā:
mn26:19.16: Itiha me bhikkhave paṭisañcikkhato appossukkatāya cittaṃ namati, no dhammadesanāya.
mn26:20.1: Atha kho bhikkhave Brahmuno Sahampatissa mama cetasā cetoparivitakkhamaññāya etad-ahosi:
mn26:20.2: Nassati vata bho loko, vinassati vata bho loko, yatra hi nāma Tathāgatassa arahato sammāsambuddhassa appossukkatāya cittaṃ namati, no dhammadesanāyāti.
mn26:20.3: Atha kho bhikkhave Brahmā Sahampati seyyathā pi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya evam-evaṃ Brahmaloke antarahito mama purato pāturahosi.
mn26:20.4: Atha kho bhikkhave Brahmā Sahampati ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yenāhaṃ ten' añjalim-paṇāmetvā maṃ etad-avoca:
mn26:20.5: Desetu bhante Bhagavā dhammaṃ, desetu Sugato dhammaṃ,
mn26:20.6: santi sattā apparajakkhajātikā assavanatā dhammassa parihāyanti,
mn26:21.1: Atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave Brahmuno ca ajjhesanaṃ viditvā sattesu ca kāruññataṃ paṭicca Buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokesiṃ.
mn26:21.2: Addasaṃ kho ahaṃ bhikkhave Buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokento satte apparajakkhe mahārajakkhe, tikkhindriye mudindriye, svākāre dvākāre, suviññāpaye duviññāpaye, app-ekacce paralokavajjabhayadassāvine viharante.
mn26:21.3: Seyyathā pi nāma uppaliniyaṃ vā paduminiyaṃ vā puṇḍarīkiniyaṃ vā app-ekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaddhāni udakā 'nuggatāni antonimuggaposīni, app-ekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaddhāni samodakaṃ ṭhitāni, app-ekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaddhāni udakā accuggamma tiṭṭhanti anupaliṭṭāni udakena,
mn26:21.4: evam-eva kho ahaṃ bhikkhave Buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokento addasaṃ satte apparajakkhe mahārajakkhe, tikkhindriye mudindriye, svākāre dvākāre, suviññāpaye duviññāpaye, app-ekacce paralokavajjabhayadassāvine viharante.
mn26:21.5: Atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave Brahmānaṃ Sahampatiṃ gāthāya paccabhāsiṃ:
mn26:21.10: Atha kho bhikkhave Brahmā Sahampati: katāvakāso kho 'mhi Bhagavatā dhammadesaṇāyāti maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth' ev' antaradhāyi.
mn26:22.2: Kassa nu kho ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ,
mn26:22.5: Ayaṃ kho Āḷāro Kālāmo paṇḍito viyatto medhāvī, dīgharattaṃ apparajakkhajātiko,
mn26:22.6: yan-nūnāhaṃ Āḷārassa Kālāmassa paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn26:22.8: Atha kho maṃ bhikkhave devatā upasaṅkamitvā etad-avocuṃ:
mn26:22.14: sace hi so imaṃ dhammaṃ suṇeyya khippam-eva ājāneyyāti.
mn26:23.2: Kassa nu kho ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ,
mn26:23.5: Ayaṃ kho Uddako Rāmaputto paṇḍito viyatto medhāvī, dīgharattaṃ apparajakkhajātiko,
mn26:23.6: yan-nūnāhaṃ Uddakassa Rāmaputtassa paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ,
mn26:23.8: Atha kho maṃ bhikkhave devatā upasaṅkamitvā etad-avocuṃ:
mn26:23.14: sace hi so imaṃ dhammaṃ suṇeyya khippam-eva ājāneyyāti.
mn26:24.2: Kassa nu kho ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ,
mn26:24.5: Bahukārā kho me pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū ye maṃ padhānapahitattaṃ upaṭṭhahiṃsu;
mn26:24.6: yan-nūnāhaṃ pañcavaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyan-ti.
mn26:24.8: Kahan-nu kho etarahi pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū viharantīti.
mn26:24.9: Addasaṃ kho ahaṃ bhikkhave dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena pañcavaggiye bhikkhū Bārāṇasiyaṃ viharante Isipatane migadāye.
mn26:24.10: Atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave Uruvelāyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Bārāṇasī tena cārikaṃ pakkāmiṃ.
mn26:25.1: Addasā kho maṃ bhikkhave Upako ājīviko antarā ca Gayaṃ antarā ca bodhiṃ addhānamaggapaṭipannaṃ,
mn26:25.3: Vippasannāni kho te āvuso indriyāni, parisuddho chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto;
mn26:25.4: kaṃ si tvaṃ āvuso uddissa pabbajito, ko vā te satthā, kassa vā tvaṃ dhammaṃ rocesīti. \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn26:25.5: Evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhikkhave Upakaṃ ājīvikaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsiṃ:
mn26:25.22: Yathā kho tvaṃ āvuso paṭijānāsi arahasi anantajino ti. --
mn26:25.27: Evaṃ vutte bhikkhave Upako ājīviko: Huveyya p' āvuso ti vatvā sīsaṃ okampetvā ummaggaṃ gahetvā pakkāmi.
mn26:26.1: Atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Bārāṇasī Isipatanaṃ migadāyo yena pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū ten' upasaṅkamiṃ.
mn26:26.2: Addasāsuṃ kho maṃ bhikkhave pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū dūrato va āgacchantaṃ,
mn26:26.4: Ayaṃ āvuso samaṇo Gotamo āgacchati, bāhuliko padhānavibbhanto āvatto bāhullāya,
mn26:26.5: so n' eva abhivādetabbo na paccuṭṭhātabbo, nāssa pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ,
mn26:26.6: api ca kho āsaṇaṃ ṭhapetabbaṃ, sace ākaṅkhissati nisīdissatīti.
mn26:26.7: Yathā yathā kho ahaṃ bhikkhave upasaṅkamāmi tathā tathā pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū nāsakkhiṃsu sakāya katikāya saṇṭhātuṃ;
mn26:26.8: app-ekacce maṃ paccuggantvā pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahesuṃ, app-ekacce āsanaṃ paññāpesuṃ, app-ekacce pādodakaṃ upaṭṭhāpesuṃ,
mn26:26.9: api ca kho maṃ nāmena ca āvusovādena ca samudācaranti.
mn26:27.1: Evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhikkhave pañcavaggiye bhikkhū etadavocaṃ:
mn26:27.2: Mā bhikkhave Tathāgataṃ nāmena ca āvusovādena ca samudācarittha.
mn26:27.3: Arahaṃ bhikkhave Tathāgato sammāsambuddho. \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn26:27.4: Odahatha bhikkhave sotaṃ, amatam-adhigataṃ, aham-anusāsāmi, ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi,
mn26:27.5: yathānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā paṭipajjamānā nacirass' eva yass' atthāya kulaputtā samma-d-eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tad-anuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissathāti.
mn26:27.6: Evaṃ vutte bhikkhave pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū maṃ etad-avocuṃ:
mn26:27.7: Tāya pi kho tvaṃ āvuso Gotama iriyāya tāya paṭipadāya tāya dukkarakārikāya nājjhagamā uttariṃ manussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ, kim-pana tvaṃ etarahi bāhuliko padhānavibbhanto āvatto bāhullāya adhigamissasi uttariṃ manussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesan-ti.
mn26:27.8: Evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhikkhave pañcavaggiye bhikkhū etad-avocaṃ:
mn26:27.9: Na bhikkhave Tathāgato bāhuliko na padhānavibbhanto na āvatto bāhullāya.
mn26:27.11: Odahatha bhikkhave sotaṃ, amatam-adhigataṃ, aham-anusāsāmi, ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi,

mn26:27.13: Dutiyam-pi kho bhikkhave pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū maṃ etad-avocuṃ:

mn26:27.18: Tatiyam-pi kho bhikkhave pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū maṃ etad-avocuṃ:
mn26:27.19: Tāya pi kho tvaṃ āvuso Gotama iriyāya . . . alamariyañāṇadassanavisesan-ti.
